headline: Stlican Shelf, Weathered Expanse Head Renewed Fighting
war_summary: Since the last bulletin the fighting has shifted again. Weathered Expanse, quiet in the previous edition, stirred to life with three strategic-base events in the final two hours and twenty-six in the day, Spirit Watch drawing the heaviest action. Stlican Shelf resumed in force after its lull, posting six events in two hours and thirty-four on the day, with The Old Mourn, Vulpine Watch, and The Pale House the leading points. Fishermans Row likewise sprang up, six events in two hours and twenty in twenty-four, centered on Arcadia and Eidolo. DeadLands, the prior bulletin's hottest ground, cooled in the last two hours but still logged fifteen day-events. Callahan's Passage recorded two fresh changes at The Latch and The Procession, while MarbanHollow continued to trade Mox. Stonecradle and King's Cage have slowed after earlier flurries. Casualty reports remain heaviest in DeadLands, Weathered Expanse, and Stlican Shelf. No victory has been declared.
